purpose: Continue the live internet scan of the parallel 12345->13524 family, promote a same-system Sr I relational motif, and route all substantive publications or information items surfaced in this pass without allowing search co-occurrence to become evidence.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative copies, repeated records, and alternate landing pages are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Identifiers, page numbers, search snippets, axis labels, catalog records and other numeric collisions are not Glob evidence unless the declared physical quantity is independently verified in authoritative source content.

sources.title: Absorption spectrum of Sr I between 1400 and 1900 Angstrom
sources.authors: C. M. Brown; M. S. Longmire; M. L. Ginter
sources.authority: Journal of the Optical Society of America / Optica Publishing Group
sources.note: Primary absorption-spectroscopy source. The article states that observed Sr I transitions originate from the 5s2 1S0 ground state into J=1-odd channels and tabulates measured frequencies including 60056.04 and 60705.36 cm^-1.

sources.title: The Ionization Potential of Si2N and Si2O
sources.authors: S. J. Paukstis; J. L. Gole; David A. Dixon; Kirk A. Peterson
sources.authority: The Journal of Physical Chemistry A / American Chemical Society
sources.note: Use the one-color resonant/nonresonant pulsed-laser ionization and time-of-flight mass-spectrometry methodology as a molecular ionization-validation reference. A search-side full-text mirror exposes 63709 cm^-1 as the nominal 7.9 eV F2 excimer photon energy, but the exact value is not promoted until independently confirmed from authoritative primary full text.

sources.title: Expanding the submillimeter wave spectroscopy and astronomical search for thioacetamide (CH3CSNH2) in the ISM
sources.note: Use the 2035-line torsion-rotation fit, rho-axis-method Hamiltonian, laboratory-to-astronomical search workflow, nondetection/upper-limit handling and survey provenance as a spectroscopy/model-validation precedent. Search results show a 97930-MHz plot window in related astronomical panels, but exact target equality is not promoted from an axis/window occurrence.

sources.title: Multiplex Chemical Imaging Based on Broadband Stimulated Raman Scattering Microscopy
sources.authors: Alejandro De la Cadena et al.
sources.note: Use broadband SRS plus differential multichannel lock-in detection and chemometric decomposition as a hyperspectral chemical-imaging reference. The value 63709 is the article identifier and therefore an M1 metadata collision, not a physical-value hit.

gated_leads.basis: A full-text mirror of the verified ACS Si2N/Si2O paper states that the F2 excimer photon energy is 7.9 eV = 63709 cm^-1. The authoritative ACS landing page verifies the experiment and 7.9-eV bound but does not expose the exact cm^-1 sentence in accessible primary text in this pass.
Search-visible figures from the thioacetamide/related acetamide astronomical analysis use a 97930-MHz plotting window. Axis-range inclusion is not an exact measured-transition claim.
A mirror of NIST ASD v5.12 line output contains 73590 cm^-1 as an atomic level in classified forbidden transitions. Species/official primary ASD query must be resolved before P1 promotion.

information_updates.finding: The 13524-family orbit 67500->65070->60057->60705 contains two separately measured Sr I absorption frequencies within the standing 1 cm^-1 target tolerance, and both belong to the common-ground-state transition system described in the same primary paper.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The motif is relationally stronger than isolated cross-species P1 hits, but its significance is unknown until topology-preserving nulls and experiment-wide multiple-testing correction are run.
